name: Mika
notes: A 4-star Cryo healer. The Burst (Skyfeather Song) heals on his Max HP, so HP is the scaling stat and the Burst is the talent that matters; his Skill (Starfrost Swirl) scales with ATK but only gives the Soulwind ATK SPD bonus and a Physical DMG bonus. KQM puts the Burst first or level with the Skill; Game8 puts the Skill first; the card follows KQM (Burst >= Skill). Both sources give 4pc Noblesse Oblige as best, ER or HP% Sands, an HP% Goblet, an HP%, Healing Bonus or CRIT Rate Circlet, and Favonius Lance, Dialogues of the Desert Sages, Rightful Reward and Black Tassel. The other sets are KQM's. The ER goal is Game8's 200%; KQM's depends on the weapon (105-140% with Dialogues of the Desert Sages R5, 160-210% with Rightful Reward R3, 175-230% with Favonius Lance, 190-250% otherwise). No source gives other stat goals.
